summary: OpenAI's CFO publishes a strategic essay on its 'abundant intelligence' economics, citing an already-announced price cut for GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra, a new Fast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol, and internal engineering efficiency and usage statistics.

mechanisms.reason: The document states concrete engineering techniques that cut compute per unit of serving work, not just a price change.
mechanisms.quote: GPT‑5.6 Sol helped optimize the production software used to serve our models, reducing end-to-end serving costs by 20 percent. It also helped improve speculative decoding, increasing token-generation efficiency by more than 15 percent.

mechanisms.reason: The document reports rising per-user message volume and growing scale of active usage across products.
mechanisms.quote: Six months after signing up, people send roughly 50 percent more messages each day and use ChatGPT for about twice as many kinds of work.

mechanisms.reason: Internal output-token share has shifted almost entirely to agent-executed work rather than seat-based use.
mechanisms.quote: Across OpenAI, agentic work through Codex now accounts for 99.8% of weekly output tokens, with Finance among the teams that have made agentic tools a primary part of how they work.

practices.reason: Speculative decoding and serving-software optimization gains are reported but tied to OpenAI's own infrastructure and not handed over as a reproducible recipe.
practices.quote: It also helped improve speculative decoding, increasing token-generation efficiency by more than 15 percent.

practices.reason: Context and reasoning-retention management produced a large stated score and token-efficiency gain on a public benchmark, but the technique itself is not specified in implementable detail.
practices.quote: improvements to retained reasoning and context management raised GPT‑5.6 Sol’s score on the public ARC-AGI-3 task set from 13.3 percent to 38.3 percent while using six times fewer output tokens.

practices.reason: The public ARC-AGI-3 task set is cited as the instrument used to measure the system-level efficiency and capability gain, which a team could run itself.
practices.quote: In a recent benchmark analysis , improvements to retained reasoning and context management raised GPT‑5.6 Sol’s score on the public ARC-AGI-3 task set from 13.3 percent to 38.3 percent while using six times fewer output tokens.

practices.reason: A new Fast mode option changes available API configuration but creates no mandatory migration work.
practices.quote: For GPT‑5.6 Sol, Fast mode delivers up to 2.5 times the speed of standard processing at twice the price, with no change in intelligence.

practices.reason: Stated price cuts and a new low-latency mode change what is economical and buildable interactively with these existing models.
practices.quote: we reduced the price of GPT‑5.6 Luna by 80 percent and GPT‑5.6 Terra by 20 percent.

notable_reason: Discloses concrete internal efficiency and adoption metrics (serving cost reduction, speculative decoding gains, 99.8% agentic token share) that are unusually specific for a strategy essay.
